trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks on its own. Use the roadmap in this guide: story first, then strangers, activities, collectibles, and the combat and money trophies last, saving the missable moments called out in the guide. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start of the story, following Lucia and Jason as they drive back into Leonida and take on the job that sets the whole plot in motion. Listen to the dialogue, follow the waypoint prompts through the drive and the meet, and finish the job the mission asks for. The trophy unlocks when the closing scene ends and the map opens up for free play. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1, the opening stretch that establishes Lucia and Jason's life in Leonida and the debts and loyalties pulling at them. Work through the chapter's jobs in order, using the mission replays and checkpoints if a section goes wrong, and keep an eye on side activities only after the chapter's story beats are done. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends and the Chapter 2 title card appears. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through all of Chapter 2, where the pair's money troubles deepen and the jobs get riskier, bigger and harder to walk away from. Take the missions as they come, lean on cover and the new gear the chapter hands you, and replay any mission from the pause menu if a gold-style run goes sideways. The trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter's last mission, once the story moves on to Chapter 3. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3, the stretch that throws Lucia and Jason into the heart of Vice City itself, with its clubs, deals and rival crews all demanding attention at once. Follow the mission markers across the city, use fast travel and safehouses to cut the downtime, and finish each job before chasing side content. The trophy pops when the chapter's closing mission ends and Chapter 4 begins. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, where the pair's rise reaches its peak and every alliance they built gets tested by rivals who want the same streets. Play the missions in order, keep your weapons and vehicle stocked between jobs, and use checkpoints generously when a shootout or chase turns messy. The trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission wraps up and the story pushes toward its endgame. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the final mission of the story to its end, the last job that decides where Lucia and Jason land after everything they have risked across Leonida. Bring your best weapons and a fast vehicle, follow the mission's twists as they come, and do not quit mid-mission, since the ending plays out in one continuous run. The gold trophy pops when the credits sequence begins. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run, an early job that tests whether Lucia and Jason can trust each other when a simple plan starts to wobble. Follow the mission prompts, stick with your partner through the drive and the handoff, and keep your cool if the job turns loud, since the mission allows a messy finish. The trophy pops when the mission's closing scene ends and you are back in the open world. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist, a big score against a cartel stash that needs planning, timing and a clean getaway. Gear up before the job starts, follow the crew's plan through the entry and the grab, and drive the escape route hard once the alarms start, since the payout depends on getting clear. The trophy pops when the crew reaches safety and the mission debrief plays. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play, a job that pulls family into the middle of Lucia and Jason's business and forces a choice about who to protect. Play it straight through, following the prompts from the pickup to the payoff, and mind the civilians in the area, since the mission's heat rises fast if things get loud. The trophy pops when the final scene ends and the family thread settles for now. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners, a loud, public job that puts Lucia and Jason in the spotlight whether they want it or not. Move fast once the job kicks off, use the crowd and the city layout to break sightlines, and keep the getaway vehicle close, since the mission's second half is a rolling escape. The trophy pops when the pair shakes the tail and the mission's closing scene plays out. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, a job at the airport that turns a routine takedown into a running fight across the terminals and the tarmac. Stay mobile, use cover between the parked aircraft, and watch the mission prompts for the moment to switch from fighting to fleeing. The trophy pops when the takedown is done and the pair clears the airport grounds for good. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory, a heavy assault job that throws everything the story has built toward into one long, hard fight. Stock up on armour and ammunition first, advance from cover to cover, and let your partner draw fire while you flank, since rushing the open ground gets you cut down fast. The trophy pops when the operation ends and the story's endgame opens up. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion by finishing the story, all stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the side goals the in-game stats page tracks. Check that page often and clear one category at a time, since the last few percent usually hide in a single unfinished strand. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the total. Chain stunts on long highway runs and at jump spots, and watch the counter on the stats page so you know how close you are. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, stunts, stranger missions and meditation spots are the kinds to sample. Dip into each one early so you learn where they live on the map. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern, steady your aim with short bursts, and replay a challenge until the gold score lands. The range tracks your best medal per challenge, so you can improve them one at a time. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates before racing for the win, cut corners only where the gates allow it, and replay a location until the win registers. The map marks each race spot once you have found it. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Pick a fast, grippy car, learn each route's braking points, and work through the race list one event at a time instead of repeating a favourite. Each distinct race you win moves the count by one. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the spot Cal fishes, match the bait to the water, and keep the line tension steady while reeling so the catch does not slip away. Win the head-to-head and the trophy is yours. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Pick the game you find easiest, learn its controls in the first round, and play through to its ending rather than chasing a high score. One finished game is all it takes. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Follow Andy's markers as they appear, do his jobs in order, and return to him whenever a new one opens up. The trophy pops when his last mission ends. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. His jobs lean on boats and the waterways, so keep a fast boat handy and follow his markers as they appear. The trophy pops when his last mission ends. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. His jobs favour bikes and open roads, so keep a quick bike ready and follow his markers as they appear. The trophy pops when his last mission ends. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Answer the stranger markers on the map, finish each strand to its last mission, and keep a note of which strangers you have finished so none is left half done. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Follow Randy's markers as they appear, do his jobs in order, and return to him whenever a new one opens up. The trophy pops when his last mission ends. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. His jobs reward steady driving and a cool head under pressure, so follow his markers as they appear. The trophy pops when his last mission ends. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Visit each marked spot, sit through the full meditation, and move on to the next; the map marks spots you have already used. A quiet, scenic route is the pleasant way to clear this one. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Track it with the hunting clues Bret gives, approach downwind and take a clean shot, then bring the prize back to him. The trophy pops once Bret accepts the hunt. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards hide in shops, safehouses and out-of-the-way corners across Leonida, so sweep each area properly and trade duplicates where the game allows it. Three finished sets earn the trophy. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. Open it at every new landmark, viewpoint and business you pass, and work it into your travels so the count climbs without grinding. The stats page shows how many spots you have covered. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge lists. Pick the easy ones first, such as driving, shooting and exploration challenges, and let the harder ones fall as you play. The challenge menu tracks your progress toward fifty. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, switch vehicles, and use alleys and tunnels to shake the search. It is repeatable open-world play, so you can retry it as often as you like. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route past three shops, keep the robberies quick, and drive straight from one to the next. It is repeatable, so a failed run costs nothing but time. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Drive everything you see, from scooters to trucks, since each new model you sit in counts once. Variety is the shortcut: a car meet or a busy street beats repeating the same ride. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Start it with a group of enemies in front of you, pick targets fast, and keep firing until the focus ends. A busy shootout is the natural place to try it, and you can retry freely. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Grab a plane on the tarmac and take off without a flight plan, or leave the airport by an exit nobody scheduled. It is a repeatable stunt, so try it as many times as you need. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks the description hints at: take one on in combat and survive the encounter. Use heavy weapons and cover, keep moving so the cannon cannot track you, and finish the fight on your feet. It is repeatable combat, so a lost attempt is just a retry. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, move quietly, take the goods and slip out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again, since the attempt is fully repeatable. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan the entry, grab the cash, and drive the getaway hard, since the heat follows at once. Five vaults, each finished with a clean escape, earn the silver. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and break away before the response arrives. Trucks run regular routes, so the attempt is repeatable whenever you are ready. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, sail and fly into every corner of the map until the area counter reads full, and use the map to spot the regions you have not visited yet. The last areas are usually the islands and the far north. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Learn which turf belongs to which gang, hit one operation per gang, and escape each time. The map and the gang markers show where each crew operates. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed: the description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no reliable step-by-step route is established yet. Try the beachfront bars along Ocean Drive at sunset and order at the bar, then revisit once the community pins the exact trigger down. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out onto the street. Pick a showroom with a clear exit, build speed inside, and enjoy the chaos. It is a repeatable stunt. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley and follow through to the end. Bowl every frame, keep your throws steady, and finish the game rather than quitting early. One completed game at that alley is what counts. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build the partnership's public appeal until this pops: play the story beats where Lucia and Jason present themselves to the world together and keep the pair's reputation high. The exact trigger is tied to story progress, so keep playing the main missions and it should land. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: This trophy can be missed: choices made during the story shape what happens next, and a choice, once made, cannot be taken back on that save. Make a manual save before big story decisions and keep a backup save from before each choice, so a decision you regret can be revisited. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed, and this trophy can be missed: the description hints at a second attempt succeeding where the first failed, and a moment that only offers a second chance once can be missed if you succeed first time or walk away. If a retry prompt appears, take it rather than leaving the scene. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed, and this trophy can be missed: the description points to a strange, unexplained event that may only trigger once under particular conditions, so walking past it or leaving the area can mean it never comes again. When something odd happens in the world, stop and watch it play out instead of driving on. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed: knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, the drive-by the name suggests. Try a slow pass past a pedestrian with a melee swing ready, and repeat it until the hit registers. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars laundering marked bills through your contacts. Take the marked bills you earn from jobs to a contact who cleans them, and repeat until the laundered total reaches 250,000 dollars. The contacts menu tracks the running total. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and vehicle upgrades as you play, and the total climbs on its own. A late shopping spree on big-ticket items clears any remainder. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Save up, visit each property's for-sale sign, and buy them one by one; the map marks properties you already own. The last garage is usually the most expensive, so keep cash in reserve. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app on your phone, and register each one you drive. Any mix of cars and bikes counts, so register as you explore. Sources: Exophase official trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: On the Spot
